versions.changelog:
tronscan-sr-governance 1.0.3

- Expanded SKILL.md with detailed documentation of each tool, including usage guidance, inputs, and responses.
- Added a dedicated "Tools" section to clarify the purpose and use-case for all APIs.
- Improved troubleshooting instructions with clearer guidance on MCP connection issues and API rate limits.
- Enhanced response instructions for chain configuration and network queries.
- No functional changes; documentation-only update.

tronscan-sr-governance 1.0.2

- No file changes detected in this version.
- Functionality and documentation remain unchanged from the previous release.

Version 1.0.1 (no file changes)

- No code or documentation changes were detected in this release.
- All features and workflows remain the same as previous version.

Initial release of tronscan-sr-governance.

- Enables querying TRON Super Representatives (SRs), witnesses, candidates, voting records, chain parameters, and governance proposals.
- Provides functions for listing SRs, checking how an address voted, chain config parameters, proposal details, and witness vote metrics/history.
- Clarifies when to use this skill versus tronscan-account-profiler for specific queries (e.g., voter lists).
- Includes troubleshooting steps for MCP connection and API rate limits.
